insights.one_liner: Karsten International is an Amsterdam scale-up that designs, produces and sells non-food consumer products and brands, and is an IND-recognised sponsor.

culture.text: About 155 people work there, in the centre of Amsterdam; it was founded in 2006 and is self-owned.
Staff often come from Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences, Inholland, VU and UvA, with backgrounds in business, marketing, communication and design.
Its values: cost-conscious, ambitious with long-term focus, always measuring and improving, and direct but respectful communication.

open.text: Karsten International B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.

growth.text: It opened an office in Guangzhou, China in 2022 to support its supply chain.
It joined forces with Remalux in the Karsten Group in 2021.
It says it works with 608 partners and sells in 28 countries.
